verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Render integrating with an organization's identity provider (SSO/SAML/OIDC login, or IdP-gated access to internal apps, deployments, or agents). The closest items do not meet the story. Managed OIDC has Render itself issue short-lived workload tokens so services can call Anthropic and OpenAI. MCP OAuth authenticates AI tools to Render. Private networking and environment isolation are network controls, not identity-provider integration.
